_about: Local-rights status per team for the late-binding local row (spec 3.12). TBA_NO_RIGHTS_HOLDER = the club holds its local rights and has announced no distributor; UNANNOUNCED = a distributor exists but this game's local row is not yet in the league file; CONFIRMED = a distributor is announced (outlet/surface/label take effect; the row renders as a normal service, no CARRIER TBA plate). simulcasts lists hand-entered OTA simulcast games (matched by ET date + opponent tricode, source-agnostic). Update when carriers are announced (Tier 1 research task, docs/research/research-changelog.md). access (optional, prompt 128) = AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE: a CONFIRMED entry states its own row's access, and it wins over data/access_profile.json; absent, the profile decides by outlet, as before; any other value makes the row UNKNOWN and prints a warning (adapters/common.py local_rights_access).

CBJ.channelDecision: Joe 2026-11-16 (prompt 132, register §77): "yes i get bluejackets too" - the Blue Jackets' own channel, which the NHL's schedule names CBJNHL and CBJHN, is on his services. It supersedes his 2026-10-14 ruling (prompt 129, register §74: "Blue Jackets NOT AVAILABLE"), which predates the fact that changed it: on 2026-10-24 the NHL and DirecTV announced a multiyear deal putting the Blue Jackets Hockey Network on DirecTV (channel 660 streaming, 660-1 satellite, Choice package or higher), and Joe's provider is DIRECTV CHOICE. The availability itself lives in data/access_profile.json. THIS ENTRY'S PRIME VIDEO ROW IS UNCHANGED: the add-on stays UNAVAILABLE by the 2026-10-06 decision above; he watches through the DirecTV channel, not Prime. Because adapters/nhl.py synthesizes this entry's row only when a game has no available local row, a game the league lists on CBJNHL or CBJHN no longer carries the Prime Video row at all.

outOfMarketStations.WWHO: CW Columbus. Not receivable in Cleveland - OUT_OF_MARKET (prompt 132, 2026-11-16, register §77). The NHL's schedule lists it as the home feed on the Blue Jackets' CW simulcast nights (2026-11-05, 2026-11-12), where it answered UNKNOWN because the Blue Jackets are this market's club. Cleveland's station for the same games is WUAB 43, in `simulcasts` below.

simulcasts.source: Blue Jackets announcement, 2026-11-02 (nhl.com/bluejackets/news/cbj-on-cw): ten Blue Jackets Hockey Network games simulcast over the air, Cleveland on "Cleveland (WUAB, MyNet, 43.1)". All 7:00 PM ET except 2027-02-08 at 7:30. Joe 2026-11-16: "select Bluejackets games are available on WUAB 43 in Cleveland - these should surface in MySportsTV and show WUAB 43 as the broadcaster".
simulcasts.note: Hand-entered, the Cavaliers' pattern (nba.CLE.simulcasts, prompts 104 and 106): ONE ROW PER OUTLET, and the row's label keeps the station. Games are matched by ET date + opponent tricode, the pair being the key: PIT and TBL each appear twice. `side` is the announcement's own home/away and is provenance, not part of the match key. The two past games (2026-11-05, 2026-11-12) are entered on purpose so a backfill of those dates reads true. Matched 2026-11-16 against the schedule rows: every one of the ten is exactly one game (register §77 lists the ids).

CLE.label: Cavaliers on DAZN (RESN)
CLE.source: Cavaliers press release 2026-09-01 (cavs.com/dazn, dazn.com/cavaliers): multi-year DAZN partnership from the 2026-27 preseason; RESN produces in-house and is the master portal brand; DAZN streams every game not selected exclusively for national broadcast (ESPN/ABC, NBC/Peacock, Prime Video), preseason included; NBA TV games co-exist
CLE.decision: Joe 2026-09-01: treat DAZN as AVAILABLE (subscribing) - product decision 7, same pattern as Apple TV (decision 4)

simulcasts.source: WOIO/WUAB announcement, 2026-09-15 (https://www.cleveland19.com/2026/09/15/cleveland-cavaliers-games-return-free-over-the-air-television-19-news/): the package is "a simulcast of the games available for free in front of the Cavaliers on DAZN paid subscription paywall offering". Joe confirms this is the complete list, not a first tranche. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE ARTICLE ON JOE'S AUTHORITY: it prints "Cleveland and Phoenix" for February 14, which is Phoenix AT Cleveland, and "Cleveland at DC", which is WAS.
simulcasts.note: 15 games per season free on DAZN and simulcast over the air. THE OUTLET IS PER GAME, not per package: thirteen of the fifteen are on WOIO, two are WUAB 43 only, and four are on both - one `outlet` field could not say that. Games are matched by ET date + opponent tricode, source-agnostic. DAL, DET and CHA EACH APPEAR TWICE, so the tricode alone is not a key and no matcher may treat it as one. `side` is the announcement's own home/away and is provenance, not part of the match key.
simulcasts.outletNote: WOIO is CBS's Cleveland station (data/row_order.json: network CBS, station WOIO, channel 19), which is why it is deliberately NOT an entry in data/access_profile.json - it resolves as CBS. WUAB 43 is its own network there and already carries RESN/DAZN inside its mark. How a simulcast row resolves its access, and how the two stations render, is prompt 105's question: prompt 104 lands the data and the artwork only, and adapters/nba.py emits no simulcast row yet.
simulcasts.confirmed: Joe, 2026-09-16 (public announcement 2026-09-15; the complete list, not a first tranche)
